title: chevreulia sarmentosa
intro: Chevreulia sarmentosa, commonly known as Chilean pennyroyal, is a flowering plant native to the Andes mountains in South America. This plant is known for its aromatic leaves and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary properties. The health benefits of Chevreulia sarmentosa include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Chevreulia sarmentosa include essential oils, such as pinocamphone and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to act as an antispasmodic and expectorant.
